description:
`function_contract_is_enforced` (src/compiler2/jobs/semantic.rs:1645, called from
`apply_function_contract` at :1620) gates spec enforcement on the CALLSITE's
code:

    surface.extern_abi.is_none()
      && !world.is_bootstrap(CodeId::from_source(violation_span.code_id))

so library-internal callsites are exempt while user callsites are enforced. Its
doc comment (:1634-1644) states the joined-evidence rationale and names the
retirement condition in-code.

Enforcement is live at user callsites -- observed directly:

    error[spec/violation]: call to `+/2` violates its @spec for arguments
      (int | :fallback, int)

## The retirement condition has NOT been met

The gate retires when activation evidence is correlation-sound, i.e. when the
fz-463 arc lands the CallSiteTargets/completeness-barrier replacement.
fz-463.3 (the CallSiteTargets split keystone) is CLOSED, but the barrier
replacement is not done.

Note that fz-463 itself is being retired as an epic during the fz-kdt
re-baseline -- most of its children turned out to be already-landed or
already-deleted. Before starting this ticket, establish what "correlation-sound"
now means against the current tree rather than against that epic's description.

## The witness set needs re-deriving -- do not trust the old one

The old ticket names three lib tests as witnesses. ONE DOES NOT EXIST:
`grep -rn "capture_abi" src/ tests/ fixtures2/` returns no matches, and no test
is named `capture_abi_correlated`. The other two survive under longer names:

    compiler2_interp_runs_range_and_map_to_list_from_backend_artifacts   drive_test.rs:5514
    compiler2_runtime_demand_settles_the_f98_orbit_fixture_without_cycling drive_test.rs:5553

Treating "3 lib tests" as a known set is no longer safe.

## Checks

- The gate is deleted and the full suite is green, OR the reason it must stay is
  recorded at semantic.rs:1645 with what specifically is not yet
  correlation-sound.
- A re-derived witness set is named in the ticket before the attempt, replacing
  the stale one.

comments.text: CONCORDANT (2026-09-03): the retirement condition ("correlation-sound activation evidence") is exactly what fz-kdt.183 (List.reduce_step/3 keyed on free vars shares one joined return across users) and fz-kdt.120 (whose honest @spec rule removes the accidental re-correlation) turned into measured facts; fz-kdt.190 records that the current enforcement is also source-order dependent. The 120 review measured that widening this gate is a MASK (a phantom and a true violation -- 00188 -- are structurally identical at the span), so this ticket stays sequenced after 183/165, not before.

title: Enforce specs at library-internal callsites once activation evidence is correlation-sound
